step1_analysis.description: A double-balanced mixer where the differential outputs (drains of the switching quad) are shorted together at node N2. This is a classic LVS extraction artifact caused by a center-tapped transformer primary being recognized as a single DC net, merging Out+, Out-, and VDD into one node. In reality, XM1/XM2 and XM3/XM5 would drive opposite ends of the transformer.

output: N2 (Shorted Out+, Out-, and VDD center-tap)

paper_reference.title: A 60GHz Outphasing Transmitter in 40nm CMOS with 15.6dBm Output Power

conversion_gain.description: Voltage gain from baseband input to upconverted RF output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to the shorted differential outputs at N2 (extraction artifact), the upconverted signals cancel out perfectly. Expected measured gain is near -infinity dB. If separated, gm * Rload ~ 5mS * 50 = 0.25 (-12dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The LO commutation is bypassed because all drains sum into N2, causing perfect cancellation of the differential RF signal.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the mixer core.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id = 0.5 * un * Cox * (W/L) * Vov^2. For W/L=10, Vov=0.4V, Id ~ 1mA per branch. Total current ~ 2mA. P = 2mA * 1.8V = 3.6mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard sky130 1.8V NMOS characteristics and the provided W/L parameters.
Target application frequency from the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the double-balanced mixer. Applies 60GHz LO and 1GHz BB signals. Measures DC power and transient output swing. Note that due to the shorted outputs (N2), the upconverted signal cancels out, leaving mostly baseband feedthrough.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Double-Balanced Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Supply and Load (N2 is the shorted transformer primary)
VDD VDD 0 1.8
RLOAD VDD N2 50

* LO Signals (60GHz)
VLO_P1 LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.3 60G 0 0 0)
VLO_P2 LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.3 60G 0 0 0)
VLO_N N3 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.3 60G 0 0 180)

* Baseband Signals (1GHz)
VBB_P LABEL_NET_5 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.2 1G 0 0 0)
VBB_N LABEL_NET_4 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.2 1G 0 0 180)

.control
op
let pdc = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print pdc

tran 1p 2n
meas tran vout_max max v(N2)
meas tran vout_min min v(N2)
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
* Approximate conversion gain (will be near zero due to shorted drains)
let conv_gain_db = 20 * log10((vout_pp / 2) / 0.2 + 1e-10)
print conv_gain_db
quit
.endc
